scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification, experimental replication or clinical authorization.

This synthesis read the supplied complete text and earlier automated image-review findings for all 42 physical pages. It did not receive page images directly. Earlier chunk-local access disclaimers describe those calls, not missing pages in the combined input.
Source hash and API receipts are supplied provenance, not recomputed or independently authenticated. No filesystem, repository, publisher site or cited study was accessed.
Historical core/L4 cells remain unchanged. Verified core membership and healthcare-WM capability remain unresolved; simulator-coupled policy/control results are preserved rather than discarded.

Approximately 19,000 trajectories, 12,450 samples and Hospital B N=3,100 are separately retained. Units, overlap, actual-human holdout provenance, partitioning and inter-section linkage remain unresolved.
Clinical-data, IRB and clinician-review statements require scope reconciliation with the declarations. Secondary human data, recruitment and clinician research participation are not interchangeable.

R1 is the only assigned readiness facet. Synthetic holdouts cannot establish R2; an external-source label cannot establish R3; actual clinician review is reported but insufficiently resolved for confirmed R4 here.

All numerical source values are retained as reported. Table 4 versus Table 13 and Table 9 versus Figure 1 are not pooled or silently reconciled. No reviewer-derived replacement percentages or curve coordinates are entered as measurements.
Unspecified action units/schedules/bundles, support, simulator equations, losses, architectures, solver and uncertainty sets prevent strong implementation, causal or safety conclusions.

No empirical effective horizon, free-running drift curve, measured clinical re-assimilation or verified receding-horizon control is established. Clinical decision indices and policy-update iterations remain distinct.
Risk-classification reliability is not twin-transition or joint-trajectory calibration. No uncertainty decomposition or clinical acceptance tolerance is inferred.

The theorem sketch does not establish its broad convergence, stochastic safety and positive fairness-improvement claims. Mathematical regularity, uncertainty coverage and clinical applicability require further evidence.
SHAP/heatmaps do not establish internal-state interpretability, causal explanation or absence of spurious correlations. Clinician-plan concordance is not a matched individual-history audit.
Decision curves and clinician preference are not realized patient/workflow benefit. Prospective trials, expanded multimodal integration and workflow deployment remain future work.
Manuscript licensing is distinct from software/model/data licensing. Code availability remains an author claim; trained weights, repository contents and independent reproducibility were not checked.
References and appendices were considered, including incomplete bibliographic entries and apparent duplicated CPO citations; cited capabilities are not inherited.
No executable JSON Schema validation, scope/reference validator, graph rebuild or regression test was run.
